title: Tesla stock drops on Q4 earnings miss, warns production growth rate will be 'notably lower' than 2023 - Yahoo Finance
snippet: S&P 500 Dow 30 Nasdaq Russell 2000 Crude Oil Gold Silver EUR/USD 10-Yr Bond GBP/USD USD/JPY Bitcoin USD CMC Crypto 200 FTSE 100 Nikkei 225 Tesla stock drops on Q4 earnings miss, warns production growth rate will be 'notably lower' than 2023 Tesla's Q4 report comes as the EV maker's stock has slipped despite a broader market rebound.  In terms of of its full-year production, Tesla said its "vehicle volume growth rate may be notably lower than the growth rate achieved in 2023, as our teams work on the launch of the next-generation vehicle at Gigafactory Texas," indicating it would not reach Street estimates of 2.19 million for 2024, which would have been a 21% increase from 2023.  "The Street views Tesla correctly (in our view) as a disruptive tech leader, and if Musk ultimately went down the path to create his own company (separate from Tesla) for his next generation AI projects this would clearly be a big negative for the Tesla story," Wedbush analyst Dan Ives wrote in a note to clients last week.  Tesla reported Q4 earnings that missed estimates and issued a downbeat full-year production outlook that weighed on the stock, continuing a downtrend for the EV maker that began at the start of the year.
